CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery" (
 "originalDispatchId" UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "replacementDispatchId" UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 "draftId" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "CreditoBorrador"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorUserId" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "Usuario"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorName" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("actorName"))>0),
 "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("reason")) BETWEEN 20 AND 500),
 "providerOutcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' CHECK ("providerOutcome"='UNKNOWN'),
 "providerReviewConfirmed" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("providerReviewConfirmed"),
 "remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted"),
 "originalFingerprint" CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 "documentHash" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "sealChecksum" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 CHECK ("originalDispatchId"<>"replacementDispatchId")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization" (
 "originalDispatchId" UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "replacementDispatchId" UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
 "firstOriginalDispatchId" UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"("originalDispatchId") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "draftId" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES "CreditoBorrador"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorUserId" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES "Usuario"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 "actorName" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("actorName"))>0),
 "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim("reason")) BETWEEN 20 AND 500),
 "providerOutcome" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'UNKNOWN' CHECK ("providerOutcome"='UNKNOWN'),
 "providerReviewConfirmed" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("providerReviewConfirmed"),
 "remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted"),
 "newChargeAccepted" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("newChargeAccepted"),
 "originalFingerprint" CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 "firstOriginalFingerprint" CHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 "authorizationFingerprint" CHAR(64) NOT NULL CHECK ("authorizationFingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 "documentHash" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "sealChecksum" CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
 "balancePositiveConfirmed" BOOLEAN NOT NULL CHECK ("balancePositiveConfirmed"),
 "balanceVerifiedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
 "balanceTypeId" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("balanceTypeId"=2),
 "signatureMethodId" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("signatureMethodId"=2),
 "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
 CHECK ("originalDispatchId"<>"replacementDispatchId" AND "firstOriginalDispatchId"<>"originalDispatchId"
   AND "firstOriginalDispatchId"<>"replacementDispatchId")
)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_paid_retry_authorization_guard()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
DECLARE first_permission "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"%ROWTYPE;
 first_dispatch "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"%ROWTYPE; leaf "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch"%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(1179865177,NEW."draftId");
 SELECT * INTO first_permission FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"
  WHERE "draftId"=NEW."draftId" AND "originalDispatchId"=NEW."firstOriginalDispatchId";
 IF NOT FOUND OR first_permission."replacementDispatchId"<>NEW."originalDispatchId" THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_PAID_RETRY_LINEAGE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO leaf FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" WHERE "id"=NEW."originalDispatchId" FOR UPDATE;
 SELECT * INTO first_dispatch FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" WHERE "id"=NEW."firstOriginalDispatchId";
 IF leaf."id" IS NULL OR first_dispatch."id" IS NULL OR first_dispatch."status"<>'ABANDONED' OR leaf."status"<>'UNCERTAIN'
  OR first_dispatch."draftId"<>NEW."draftId" OR leaf."draftId"<>NEW."draftId"
  OR first_dispatch."processUuid" IS NOT NULL OR leaf."processUuid" IS NOT NULL
  OR first_dispatch."expectedProcessUuid" IS NOT NULL OR leaf."expectedProcessUuid" IS NOT NULL
  OR first_dispatch."acknowledgedAt" IS NOT NULL OR leaf."acknowledgedAt" IS NOT NULL
  OR first_dispatch."dispatchedAt" IS NULL OR leaf."dispatchedAt" IS NULL
  OR first_dispatch."reason"<>'Envío del contrato de la solicitud a FirmaSeguro'
  OR leaf."reason"<>'Envío del contrato de la solicitud a FirmaSeguro'
  OR first_dispatch."lastError" IS DISTINCT FROM 'provider_dispatch [UNKNOWN]: Ocurrió un error: No posees saldo suficiente para realizar la operación. Firma seguro method -> Firma Electrónica Certificada - OTP Whatsapp, balanceType -> 2 (HTTP 500 en /api/v2/Process/create-full)'
  OR leaf."lastError" IS DISTINCT FROM 'provider_dispatch [UNKNOWN]: Ocurrió un error: No posees saldo suficiente para realizar la operación. Firma seguro method -> Firma Electrónica Certificada - OTP Whatsapp, balanceType -> 2 (HTTP 500 en /api/v2/Process/create-full)'
  OR NEW."originalFingerprint"<>md5((to_jsonb(leaf)-'status'-'updatedAt')::text)
  OR NEW."firstOriginalFingerprint"<>md5((to_jsonb(first_dispatch)-'status'-'updatedAt')::text)
  OR first_permission."originalFingerprint"<>NEW."firstOriginalFingerprint"
  OR NEW."documentHash" IS DISTINCT FROM leaf."documentHash"
  OR first_permission."documentHash" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."documentHash"
  OR NEW."sealChecksum" IS DISTINCT FROM leaf."draftPayload"#>>'{financialTermsSeal,checksum}'
  OR first_permission."sealChecksum" IS DISTINCT FROM NEW."sealChecksum"
  OR encode(sha256(decode(leaf."documentBase64",'base64')),'hex')<>NEW."documentHash"
  OR convert_from(substring(decode(leaf."documentBase64",'base64') FROM 1 FOR 5),'UTF8')<>'%PDF-'
  OR ROW(first_dispatch."draftFolio",first_dispatch."updatedPayload",first_dispatch."draftPayload",first_dispatch."frozenCredit",first_dispatch."documentBase64",first_dispatch."documentHash")
    IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(leaf."draftFolio",leaf."updatedPayload",leaf."draftPayload",leaf."frozenCredit",leaf."documentBase64",leaf."documentHash")
  OR leaf."sourcePayload" IS DISTINCT FROM first_dispatch."updatedPayload"
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_PAID_RETRY_FROZEN_SOURCE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" WHERE "id"=NEW."replacementDispatchId")
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" WHERE "draftId"=NEW."draftId"
   AND "id" NOT IN(NEW."firstOriginalDispatchId",NEW."originalDispatchId"))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroProcess" WHERE "draftId"=NEW."draftId")
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReceipt" r JOIN "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" d ON d."id"=r."dispatchId" WHERE d."draftId"=NEW."draftId")
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReconciliation" r JOIN "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" d ON d."id"=r."dispatchId" WHERE d."draftId"=NEW."draftId")
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftRecovery" WHERE "dispatchId" IN(NEW."firstOriginalDispatchId",NEW."originalDispatchId"))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_PAID_RETRY_EVIDENCE_CHANGED' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Usuario" u JOIN "Rol" r ON r."id"=u."rolId"
   JOIN "Sede" s ON s."id"=u."sedeId" JOIN "Aliado" a ON a."id"=s."aliadoId"
   WHERE u."id"=NEW."actorUserId" AND u."activo" AND s."activa" AND a."activo"
    AND upper(btrim(r."nombre"))='ADMIN' AND upper(btrim(a."codigo"))='FINSERPAY'
    AND btrim(u."nombre")=NEW."actorName")
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "CreditoBorrador" d WHERE d."id"=NEW."draftId" AND d."estado"='ABIERTO'
   AND d."creditoId" IS NULL AND d."currentStep" IN(3,4) AND d."payload"=leaf."updatedPayload"
   AND COALESCE(d."expiresAt",d."createdAt"+INTERVAL '15 days')>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
  OR NEW."balanceVerifiedAt"<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP-INTERVAL '2 minutes'
  OR NEW."balanceVerifiedAt">CURRENT_TIMESTAMP+INTERVAL '1 minute'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_PAID_RETRY_AUTHORIZATION_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization_guard" BEFORE INSERT ON "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_paid_retry_authorization_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativePermission" AS
 SELECT "originalDispatchId","replacementDispatchId","draftId","actorUserId","actorName","reason",
  "providerOutcome","providerReviewConfirmed","remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted","originalFingerprint","documentHash","sealChecksum","createdAt"
 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"
 UNION ALL
 SELECT "originalDispatchId","replacementDispatchId","draftId","actorUserId","actorName","reason",
  "providerOutcome","providerReviewConfirmed","remoteOutcomeUnknownAccepted","originalFingerprint","documentHash","sealChecksum","createdAt"
 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization"

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_immutable()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_ADMINISTRATIVE_AUDIT_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_immutable"
 BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_immutable()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_receipt"
 BEFORE INSERT ON "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReceipt"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_receipt_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativeRecovery_reconciliation"
 BEFORE INSERT ON "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatchReconciliation"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_receipt_guard()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_draft_freeze()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "FirmaSeguroDraftAdministrativePermission" permission
  JOIN "FirmaSeguroDraftDispatch" replacement ON replacement."id"=permission."replacementDispatchId"
  WHERE permission."draftId"=OLD."id" AND replacement."status"='PREPARING') THEN
  -- Ordinary expiry closes the request but cannot change its frozen contract.
  IF OLD."estado"='ABIERTO' AND NEW."estado"='CERRADO'
   AND COALESCE(OLD."expiresAt",OLD."createdAt"+INTERVAL '15 days')<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
   AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'estado'-'closedAt'-'closedReason'-'updatedAt')=
       (to_jsonb(OLD)-'estado'-'closedAt'-'closedReason'-'updatedAt')
   AND NEW."payload" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD."payload" THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'updatedAt'-'currentStep') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'updatedAt'-'currentStep')
   OR NEW."currentStep" NOT IN(3,4) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'DRAFT_ADMINISTRATIVE_CONTRACT_FROZEN' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $$

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "CreditoBorrador_administrative_recovery_freeze"
 BEFORE UPDATE ON "CreditoBorrador"
 FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_draft_freeze()

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization_immutable" BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON "FirmaSeguroDraftPaidRetryAuthorization" FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.firmaseguro_draft_administrative_recovery_immutable()
